CHARACTER CLASSES
There are '''sixteen total classes''' in EverQuest Legends. Each class belongs to one of four archetypes: '''casters''', '''priests''', '''melee''', and '''hybrids'''.
There are no experience penalties for any specific class. EverQuest Legends also allows players to mix classes, creating custom class combinations and trio builds.


[[Class_Guides|View Build Guides]]
| style="width:360px; padding:18px; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle;" | [[File:Firionaboxart.webp|340x340px]] |}

CASTERS

Casters specialize in spell damage, control, pets, utility, mana tools, and magical burst.

  • [[Enchanter|Enchanter]] (ENC)
  • [[Magician|Magician]] (MAG)
  • [[Necromancer|Necromancer]] (NEC)
  • [[Wizard|Wizard]] (WIZ)

PRIESTS

Priests provide healing, buffs, debuffs, recovery tools, utility, and group support.

  • [[Cleric|Cleric]] (CLR)
  • [[Druid|Druid]] (DRU)
  • [[Shaman|Shaman]] (SHM)

MELEE

Melee classes focus on weapon-based combat, sustained damage, pulling, disciplines, positioning, and direct physical pressure.

  • [[Berserker|Berserker]] (BER)
  • [[Monk|Monk]] (MNK)
  • [[Rogue|Rogue]] (ROG)
  • [[Warrior|Warrior]] (WAR)

HYBRIDS

Hybrids blend martial combat with magic, songs, pets, utility, tanking tools, tracking, and specialized group support.

  • [[Bard|Bard]] (BRD)
  • [[Beastlord|Beastlord]] (BST)
  • [[Paladin|Paladin]] (PAL)
  • [[Ranger|Ranger]] (RNG)
  • [[Shadow Knight|Shadow Knight]] (SHD)

CLASS MIXING
EverQuest Legends allows class combinations, giving players more flexibility than a traditional single-class setup. For practical examples, recommended trios, strengths, weaknesses, and progression advice, see the [[Build_Guides|Build Guides]] page. |}
